# Zapiya – #1 Free ATS Resume Builder

> Zapiya (https://www.zapiya.com) is a 100% free online ATS resume builder engineered for software engineers, developers, and students. It offers battle-tested Harvard single-column and tech-standard ATS formats, client-side privacy, zero login or signup requirements, zero watermarks, zero paywalls, and instant vector PDF downloads.

## Core Capabilities
- **Single-Column Harvard ATS Standard**: Battle-tested layout guaranteed to achieve 100/100 parsing score on Workday, Greenhouse, Taleo, and Lever.
- **100% Free Forever**: No hidden fees, no subscription traps, no credit card required, and no paywalls when downloading.
- **Zero Login or Signup Required**: Users can build and export resumes immediately with zero friction.
- **Real Vector PDF Export**: Generates crisp, selectable-text vector PDFs in-browser without pixelation or watermarks.
- **Client-Side Privacy**: Resume data is stored locally in the browser (`localStorage`) with optional JSON backup/restore; no personal data is sent to external databases.
- **Configurable Spacing & Typography**: Recruiter-approved Times New Roman typography with compact, normal, and relaxed vertical spacing options.
